title: Diagnostic Campus Factor — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Finance schedule.** When diagnostic tests on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) are retained on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), the diagnostic campus factor multiplies the sum of the test values:

| Campus | Factor |
|---|---|
| Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah | 0.95 |
| Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton | 1.04 |
| otherwise (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton) | 1 |

Example (hypothetical): test values summing to 1,000.00 give 950.00 at Neenah, 1,040.00 at Chilton and 1,000.00 at Appleton.
